correctness.rationale: The exact three-round Hintikka signature T3(P) is the set of T2(x) over x, where T2(x) collects T1(x,y), and T1(x,y) collects all atomic order/equality triples with third point z; equality of these nested finite sets is equivalent to three-round back-and-forth, including repeated selections. A three-move EF strategy on chains of length at least 7 preserves short gaps exactly and larger gaps by threshold 2^r-1; applying independent coordinate strategies to each chosen point preserves product-order atomic relations. Therefore every grid is rank-three equivalent to a side-length <=7 grid. Unordered pairs 1<=a<=b<=7 give precisely 28 finite cases. A separately written exact atomic-type enumeration recovered 21 classes with group sizes seventeen singletons, three pairs and one five-member group; reps align with the stated rowwise kappa formula, and the largest least representative C5×C6 has 30 elements. This is exhaustive only after the mathematical unbounded reduction, not by finite evidence alone.
